title: Mack Superliner Aluminium Bullbar #12
description: Mack Superliner FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Chrome plate over tow hitch can be painted black or to suit chassis. Indicator and daytime running lights in channel. Full length box uprights for maximum protection. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs, cow catcher and 5 small uprights. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
